prompts.text: A cat sitting on a keyboard, arms outstretched like it's conducting an orchestra.
Your team's group chat after someone deploys to production on a Friday.
A tiny dog wearing sunglasses on a skateboard, cruising past a fire hydrant.
The office fridge: one sad carton of milk and a wilting salad from last week.
A squirrel standing on two legs, holding an acorn like it's about to give a toast.
The 'meeting could have been an email' stare across the table.
A penguin in a business suit carrying a briefcase through a blizzard.
Someone's camera-on moment where they forgot the blur was off.
A goldfish doing a dramatic slow-motion dive into a bowl of cereal.
The standup where everyone says 'no blockers' but someone's code is on fire.
A baby goat standing on the back of a sheep, surveying its kingdom.
That screenshot from the screenshare that became a meme instantly.
